description: This PHP source file defines the 'AuthProviderExtraDetails' class within the OrangeHRM project, representing additional details for an authentication provider related to OpenID integration. It includes properties for provider associations and credentials, with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class is mapped to a database table using Doctrine ORM annotations.
